title: Oxford Nanopore WGS of Girardia dorotocephala clonal line MA-C2: whole organism
design_description: High-molecular-weight DNA (GuSCN/sarkosyl lysis and CTAB cleanup; Grohme et al. 2018) from 20 pooled animals. One ligation library (SQK-LSK114-XL) sequenced on two PromethION R10.4.1 flow cells (FLO-PRO114M; PBE82635 and PBE69031) for 72 h each with a nuclease flush. Basecalled live with Dorado SUP dna_r10.4.1_e8.2_400bps_sup@v4.3.0 (MinKNOW 24.11.11); pass reads (mean Q >= 10), one file per flow cell.
